# Chinese Huayan

The Dushun-attributed contemplation carries the jewel net; attribution remains disputed. Indra’s celestial setting and Indian name remain distinct from the Chinese Huayan doctrinal carrier. Cleary’s 1983 and 2000 translation containers remain distinct; neither dates the narrated heaven.

The [geographical route](../../atlas/geography/README.md) and [temporal route](../../atlas/temporality/README.md) **returns-to** these same wholes.
